status_meaning.unverified_default: Planning default chosen so the system runs end to end. Not yet checked against a published source. The UI must show an 'unverified default' badge for any number that depends on it.
status_meaning.sourced: Value checked against the cited source. Person 1 changes status to sourced only after recording the source string.

electricity_rate_usd_per_kwh.description: Residential electricity price used to convert kWh to dollars.

lighting_hours_per_day.description: Average daily operating hours per light fixture.

bulb_w_incandescent.description: Wattage assumed for a bulb whose type is unknown or incandescent.

bulb_w_led.description: Wattage of an equivalent LED bulb.

default_unit_floor_area_m2.description: Used only when neither CoStar nor Matterport rooms provide a unit floor area.

cooling_kwh_per_m2_yr.description: Unit cooling electricity intensity by city and construction vintage. Vintage: pre1980 if year_built < 1980, post2005 if year_built > 2005, otherwise 1980_2005; unknown year uses 1980_2005.

window_solar_cooling_kwh_per_m2_yr.description: Cooling electricity attributable to solar gain per square metre of window.

window_film_reduction.description: Fraction of window solar cooling removed by solar control film.

window_film_cap_fraction.description: Window film savings may not exceed this fraction of the current cooling kWh.

eer_window_ac_old.description: Efficiency assumed for an existing window AC unit of unknown model.

eer_heat_pump_new.description: Efficiency of a new ductless heat pump.

thermostat_hvac_savings_fraction.description: Fraction of remaining cooling kWh saved by a smart thermostat on a central system.

fridge_kwh_yr_old.description: Annual use assumed for an existing refrigerator of unknown age.

fridge_kwh_yr_new.description: Annual use of a replacement efficient refrigerator.

heat_share_volume_weight_per_m3.description: Heat-map weight per cubic metre of room volume.

heat_share_window_weight_per_m2.description: Heat-map weight per square metre of window in the room.

default_room_height_m.description: Used when Matterport does not report a room height.

kbtu_per_ft2_to_kwh_per_m2.description: Converts EBEWE site EUI to kWh per square metre.
